### Borea v0.6.5

A patch release that shows what is new after an update and lets you copy texts and errors. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### What's new

- After an update, Borea shows the release notes of the new version once.
- Settings > About has a "What's new" button that opens these notes at any time.
- You can now select and copy the texts of mod and pack pages, error messages, ids, folders and file paths.
- Borea now keeps the settings it does not know and writes them back when it saves, so going back to an older version no longer resets your settings.

#### For stewards

- The Statistics tab shows mod packs that do not fit the current build in a column of their own, and the tooltip says why.

#### Good to know

- Going back from v0.6.5 to v0.6.4 or older resets your settings once, because those versions do not know the keys that v0.6.5 adds.
- In Simplified Chinese, the new texts show in English until they are translated.

Full changelog: [v0.6.4...v0.6.5](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.4...v0.6.5)
